## App templates note

There are **no Jinja/HTML templates** under `app/templates/` in this repo. Legacy routes are redirected in `c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\app\spa.py`; the UI is entirely the React SPA in `frontend/`. Column-level tooltips still come from the Flask JSON layer (e.g. `app/services/tournament_service.py` + `app/services/i18n_service.py`).

---

## 1. Explanatory text, tooltips, empty states by page type

### Player (`/spieler`)
**Entry:** `c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\pages\player\PlayerStats.tsx`  
**Blocks:** `blocks/LifetimeStats.tsx`, `CompetitionBreakdownCharts.tsx`, `PlayerHighlights.tsx`, `TrendChart.tsx`, `SeasonStats.tsx`

| UX element | What exists |
|------------|-------------|
| Page intro | Title + scope only (player name, “Alle Spieler”, or “Spieler · {club}” with MyClub). **No page-level description.** |
| Section hints | Yes on richer blocks: competition breakdown (“Schnitt und Spielanteil je Wettbewerb…”), highlights (“Top-5/Top-10 je Kategorie”). |
| Tooltips | ECharts tooltips; table `tooltips: true` where used; `title` on truncated labels in highlights. **No column glossary.** |
| Empty states | `player_not_found`, dashed `no_data_desc`, per-block “Keine Saisondaten/Wettbewerbsdaten”, highlights filter empty. |
| Help controls | Min-games filter toggles on highlight categories (buttons only; thresholds live in `lib/playerHighlights.ts`, not explained in UI). |

**Explanation vs density:** **Medium explanation, high density.** Lifetime stats are label/value only. Highlights + breakdown charts carry most of the “what am I looking at?” copy; default “all players” view is very data-heavy with little onboarding.

---

### Club / Team (`/club`, legacy `/mannschaft`)
**Entry:** `c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\pages\team\TeamStats.tsx`  
**Blocks:** `ClubOverview.tsx`, `ClubLegends.tsx`, `ClubPlayerResults.tsx`, `TeamDetail.tsx` (+ `ClutchAnalysisSection.tsx`, `ConsistencySection.tsx`, etc.)

| UX element | What exists |
|------------|-------------|
| Page intro | **Only page with a real subtitle:** `ui.team.page_desc` — club overview + per-team analysis. |
| Section hints | Position history, team cards, club legends, player results table each have `_hint` lines. |
| Tooltips | Matrix cell `title` for “Liga öffnen”; chart axis tooltips. |
| Empty states | “Wähle einen Club…”, `no_teams_for_club`, generic `no_data` in team drill-down sections. |
| Help controls | Clutch threshold slider labeled “Clutch-Schwelle (Punkte)” but **no definition of “Clutch”**; collapsible sections organize density. |

**Explanation vs density:** **Highest explanation on club overview** (page desc + multiple hints). Team detail is **dense analytics** (charts/tables) with section titles only.

---

### League (`/liga`)
**Entry:** `c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\pages\league\LeagueStats.tsx`  
**Filter:** `LeagueFilterBar.tsx`  
**Blocks:** `SeasonLeagueStandings.tsx`, `LeagueOverview.tsx`, `LeagueSeasonOverview.tsx`, `Matchday.tsx`, `TeamPerformance.tsx`, `TeamDetails.tsx`, `GameBlocks.tsx`, `leagueBlockUi.tsx`

| UX element | What exists |
|------------|-------------|
| Page intro | Season in H1 only. **No page description.** |
| Section hints | Sparse — chart/table section eyebrows/titles only (e.g. “Liga-Leistung über alle Saisons”). Honor scores sidebar has no intro text. |
| Tooltips | Widespread `tooltips: true` on DataTables; shared empty/error in `leagueBlockUi.tsx`. |
| Empty states | Generic “Keine Daten vorhanden.” / `no_data_available_for` for season standings. |
| Help controls | **None** — navigation is entirely filter-driven (season → league → week → team → round). |

**Explanation vs density:** **Lowest explanation, highest density.** Assumes users know league drill-down; tables and charts dominate.

---

### Tournament (`/turnier`)
**Entry:** `c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\pages\tournament\TournamentStats.tsx`  
**Filter + help:** `TournamentFilterBar.tsx` (format info modal)  
**Blocks:** `TournamentPodiumOverview.tsx`, `SummaryCards.tsx`, `Leaderboard.tsx`, `PlayerSection.tsx`, `BestEfforts.tsx`, `KoBracket.tsx`, etc.

| UX element | What exists |
|------------|-------------|
| Page intro | Tournament name in H1 only. |
| Section hints | Podium overview, average history, player position history (“niedrigere Zahl ist besser”). Club300-style hints on overview chart. |
| Tooltips | **Richest help surface:** `TournamentFormatModal` (rounds, handicap usage, KO/cut rules, config file notes). Table column tooltips from API (`handicap_per_game_tooltip`, etc.). Heatmap toggle on player detail. |
| Empty states | Per-mode messages (`podium_empty`, `no_player_data`, `player_overview_empty`, `no_entries`). |
| Help controls | **Info (ℹ) button** next to tournament selector when event detail is open — opens format modal. Leaderboard net/scratch sort toggle without long explanation. |

**Explanation vs density:** **Mixed.** Overview/player modes are table-heavy; **event detail + format modal** are the main terminology explainer. Player drill-down is very dense (cards, charts, heatmap, round table).

## 2. “First visit” / contextual help patterns

**No onboarding tour, no `firstVisit` / `hasSeen` flags** (only `localStorage` for sidebar collapse, theme, language).

Patterns that exist:

| Pattern | Where |
|---------|--------|
| Landing explainer | `frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx` — PoC description, BBU credit, example deep links via `lib/homeExamples.ts` |
| Sticky filter rails | Player, league, tournament, club — teach navigation by progressive disclosure |
| Section `_hint` subtitles | Club, player highlights/breakdown, tournament overview, Club300 |
| Persistent contextual ribbon | `MyClubBanner.tsx` when `?myClub=` is set |
| Sidebar micro-hint | `MyClubControl.tsx` — “Filter aktiv · bleibt in der URL” |
| Modal contextual help | `TournamentFilterBar.tsx` → `TournamentFormatModal` |
| Dev-only long descriptions | `frontend/src/pages/diagnosis/*` (validation methodology paragraphs) |
| Shared empty/error primitives | `league/blocks/leagueBlockUi.tsx`, dashed-border sections across pages |

## 3. MyClub feature — personalization

**Core files:**
- `c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\lib\myClub.ts`
- `c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\hooks\useMyClub.ts`
- `c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\components\MyClubControl.tsx`
- `c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\components\MyClubBanner.tsx`

**Mechanism:** Global query param `?myClub={club}` (not stripped by route sanitizer per `lib/navigationQuery.ts`). Set from sidebar; cleared via banner X.

**Per-page behavior:**

| Page | Personalization |
|------|-----------------|
| **Player** | Player search scoped to club; headline “Spieler · {club}”; invalid player cleared |
| **Club/Team** | Club picker hidden; club locked to resolved name; foreign `team` cleared from URL |
| **League** | Seasons/leagues/teams filtered to club matrix participation; stale filters auto-dropped |
| **Tournament** | Seasons/tournaments/podiums API-filtered by club; invalid season/tournament cleared |
| **Club 300** | Games filtered to club players; subtitle/empty copy switch |

Banner text: “Liga & Turnier auf Club-Teilnahmen gefiltert” (player/club pages filter silently).

---

## 4. Glossary / terminology

**No glossary page or glossary component** in `frontend/`.

Terminology is scattered:

- **Inline labels** — Scratch, Netto, Hcp, Cutline, Apriori, EDV-ID, etc. via i18n (`useTranslations` + `app/services/i18n_service.py`)
- **Column header tooltips** — native `title` on headers when `tooltips: true` + backend `Column.tooltip` (tournament handicap columns)
- **Tournament format modal** — closest thing to a rules glossary (KO stepladder, cuts, handicap columns)
- **Implicit domain terms** — “Club” vs “Mannschaft” on team page; “Club-Legenden” is a feature name, not a glossary
- **Planned but not built** — `TEAM_STATS_ENHANCEMENT_PLAN.md` mentions “comprehensive data glossary” as TODO

---

## Summary: explanation vs data density

| Page type | Explanation | Data density | Primary help surfaces |
|-----------|-------------|----------------|------------------------|
| **Home** | High (only non-stats landing) | Low | Welcome copy, example links |
| **Player** | Medium (block hints) | High | Highlights/breakdown hints; empty/warning states |
| **Club/Team** | Medium–high on overview | High on team detail | `page_desc`, section hints, club legends |
| **League** | Low | Very high | Filter bar only; generic empty states |
| **Tournament** | Medium (modal + some hints) | Very high | Format info modal, API column tooltips |
| **Club 300** | High | Medium | Subtitle + per-chart hints |

**Cross-cutting:** dashed-border empty states, loading skeletons, error banners, ECharts/DataTable tooltips. **Missing across stats pages:** first-visit guidance, unified glossary, and league/player page-level “how to use this view” copy (club and Club300 are the exceptions).
